description:
README.md lines 343-353 documents the ClientConfig field set:
  request_timeout, max_session_body, max_call_body, max_download_body,
  max_upload_response_body, max_sse_frame

Source (client.rs:38-81) has a seventh field, max_ws_message (default 1 MiB, bd:JMAP-6lsm.5), used by JmapClient::connect_ws_session and exposed publicly. README's later prose at line 498 mentions 'Incoming messages are capped at 1 MiB' but does not say the cap is configurable, and the field is absent from the ClientConfig reference block.

Trigger: a user who wants to tune the WebSocket message cap reads the README and concludes it's hardcoded; they either ignore it or open an issue asking for the feature that already exists.

Fix: add max_ws_message to the README's ClientConfig field listing and to the default-values prose.
title: README ClientConfig section missing max_ws_message field
